title: Valvoline Instant Oil Change® Introduces The Ride Wrangler℠ to Remind Drivers to Change Wisely℠
summary: The new campaign created with creative AOR 3Headed Monster brings cowboy common sense to the quick oil change category with humor and a focus on smarter decision making Valvoline Instant Oil Change is setting out to redefine the quick oil change category with the launch of “The Ride Wrangler,” a new integrated brand campaign developed in partnership with creative agency 3Headed Monster . At a time when many quick service brands compete on speed, discounts, and pressure tactics, Valvoline Instant Oil Change is positioning itself as the smart choice for drivers looking for trusted expertise and confidence in their vehicle care decisions. At the center of the campaign is "The Ride Wrangler," a cowboy sage who helps drivers cut through uncertainty with straightforward wisdom, a dose of humor and his core truth of ‘change wisely.’ “‘The Ride Wrangler’ was created to capture the confidence and know-how that defines the Valvoline Instant Oil Change experience,” said Jake Lestan, Vice
